title: The Instructions for Feeding the Sourdough
youtube_title: The Instructions for Feeding the Sourdough | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Listening all the way through is a gift you can give today.
summary: At a kitchen table before breakfast, chairs close, Mama begins to tell Nils about instructions for the sourdough that included what not to do. Nils wants to interrupt with bigger news, but listens all the way to the last sentence, asks one real question, and only then shares something small of their own.
